run_check_dependencies: run the dependency checker to verify Node.js, pnpm, uv, and nginx are installed
find_pnpm_command: find the pnpm command path on this machine, falling back to corepack if needed
run_command: run a shell command and return its trimmed stdout or None on failure
parse_node_major: parse a Node.js version string and return the major version number
configure_stdio: configure stdout and stderr to use UTF-8 encoding for cross-platform compatibility
